pyramiding_rule: Prohibit adding to positions unless the initial trade has locked in a trailing profit equal to 1x the average true range.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce a minimum 1.5 ATR buffer for initial stop-loss placement and verify zero high-impact liquidity wicks in the preceding 15-minute candle.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger Sentinel Peak Harvest once open profit crosses +$15.00 to prevent evaporation of floating gains.
